hip-97649.x: Fourth planet of Altair visited by United Planets Cruiser C-57D, housing the subterranean Great Machine of the extinct Krell in Forbidden Planet (1956).
Designated stargate coordinate orbiting Altair where SG-1 encounters Harlan, the last survivor of a long-extinct civilization preserved in synthetic android bodies.

saturn.x: Spherical Einstein-Rosen wormhole orbiting Saturn providing a gateway to the supermassive black hole Gargantua, later orbited by the cylinder habitat Cooper Station.
Saturnian moon revealed to be an ancient camouflaged interstellar vehicle that suddenly ignites and accelerates out of the Solar System.
Outer Solar System arrival and resource-harvesting staging base for the invading Fithp armada before striking Earth.
Vast android civilization flourishing in floating Saturnian habitats and airless moons long after the extinction of biological humanity.
Fleet of immense geodesic greenhouse cargo freighters orbiting Saturn preserving the last specimens of Earth’s extinct forests and plant life.

proxima-centauri-b.x: Closest known extrasolar planet in a habitable zone, orbiting Sol’s nearest stellar neighbor at 4.25 light-years under extreme stellar flare irradiation.
